ScriptableObject — the ONLY cross-scene state
project rule: no singletons, no DontDestroyOnLoad

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Systems_ContestSpawner.SpawnAndBegin(int[])
1 — build each fighter under an INACTIVE holder
2 — Configure(): set observation size from the agent
3 — reparent to scene root → Awake/OnEnable fire HERE
4 — wake ContestSystems, hand over to the referee

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Why the inactive holder
Agent.LazyInitialize snapshots BrainParameters to build
the VectorSensor. Instantiating straight into the scene
runs it BEFORE Configure corrects the width — measured
44,429 truncation warnings in one session.
